# Tasks Document Tasks are ordered so that dependencies flow naturally: schema and content first, then the query layer, then components and routes, then syndication, then verification scaffolding (lint rule, scripts, CI), and finally test suites. Each task references the design section that pins its behavior and the requirements it satisfies. - [ ] 1. Add new runtime/dev dependencies to package.json with exact pins - File: package.json - Add devDependencies: `rehype-pretty-code`, `shiki`, `remark-gfm`, `remark-parse`, `remark-mdx`, `unist-util-visit`, `mdast-util-to-string`, `reading-time` (and ensure `unified` resolves transitively or add explicitly), plus `fast-xml-parser` (exact-pinned at install time). - Add dependency: `feed` pinned **exactly** as `"4.2.2"` (no caret, no tilde). - Add top-level `"engines": { "node": ">=24" }`. - Do NOT bump existing dependency versions. - Purpose: Provide the parser/highlighter/feed/XML-parser building blocks the design depends on. - _Leverage: existing package.json structure_ - _Requirements: 1.5, 9.0, 9.4, 11.0_ - _Design refs: "package.json and .nvmrc pins" section; exact-pin discipline_ - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec blog-core, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Build/DevOps engineer with deep familiarity with pnpm and Node toolchains | Task: Add the listed dependencies to package.json following requirements 1.5/9.0/11.0 and the design's "package.json and .nvmrc pins" section. The `feed` package MUST be pinned exactly as `"4.2.2"`. `fast-xml-parser` MUST also be exact-pinned (latest 4.5.x stable). Run `pnpm install` to update the lockfile. Mark the task in-progress before starting and call log-implementation when done. | Restrictions: Do not modify existing dependency versions, do not introduce yarn/npm lockfile artifacts, do not change `packageManager`. Do NOT use caret/tilde for `feed` or `fast-xml-parser`. | _Leverage: existing package.json structure | _Requirements: 1.5, 9.0, 9.4, 11.0 | Success: `pnpm install` succeeds, lockfile updated, exact pins verified by grep, `engines.node` present. Then mark the task complete after logging._ - [ ] 2. Create `rehypeAbsolutizeUrls` and `countWordsFromMdast` build-time helpers - Files: velite-helpers/rehype-absolutize-urls.mjs (or .ts), velite-helpers/word-count.mjs - `rehypeAbsolutizeUrls({ baseUrl })`: HAST visitor factory that rewrites `` / `` relative/root-relative URLs to absolute via `new URL(value, baseUrl)`. Stateless instance. - `countWordsFromMdast(tree)`: walks mdast, drops `code` and `html` node types, flattens via `mdast-util-to-string({ includeImageAlt: true })`, returns `text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length`. - Co-locate at project root next to `velite.config.ts` (no `src/lib/` slot — these are build-time helpers). - Purpose: Single source of truth for URL absolutization and word counting; both consumed by velite config AND by unit tests. - _Leverage: none new (uses mdast-util-to-string + unist-util-visit)_ - _Requirements: 6.1, 6.5, 11.8_ - _Design refs: "rehypeAbsolutizeUrls" pin under Velite collection section; "Shared walk extraction" pin in Testing Strategy_ - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec blog-core, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Build-pipeline engineer with expertise in unified/remark/rehype | Task: Implement the two helpers per the design's "rehypeAbsolutizeUrls" pin and "Shared walk extraction" pin. Both must be importable from both `velite.config.ts` and Vitest tests. Mark task in-progress before starting and call log-implementation when done. | Restrictions: Pure functions only. No per-file mutable state. Do NOT inline either helper directly in velite.config.ts — they need to be shared with tests. Splitter regex MUST be exactly `/\s+/` followed by `.filter(Boolean)`. | _Leverage: nothing existing | _Requirements: 6.1, 6.5, 11.8 | Success: Helpers export correctly, ESM-compatible, no lint errors, type-checked. Then mark the task complete after logging._ - [ ] 3. Then mark the task complete after logging._ - [ ] 4. Add the `posts` Velite collection schema with rejection visitor and reading-time transform - File: velite.config.ts (continue from task 3) - Define `posts` collection: `pattern: "posts/*.mdx"`, `.strict()` schema with all Post fields per design Data Models section (title, description, date, tags, categories, updated?, draft default false, series?, seriesOrder?, slug derived from `s.path()`). - Kebab-slug regex enforcement on `tags`/`categories` items with the exact error message from Req 4.6. - Transform pipeline (order: **rejection → reading-time → bodyHtml emit**): - Step 1: rejection visitor — parse with `remark-parse + remark-gfm + remark-mdx`, wrap parse in try/catch (emit `mdx-parse-failure` named error on throw), walk tree throwing named errors on `type: 'html'`, `mdxJsxFlowElement`, `mdxJsxTextElement`, `mdxFlowExpression`, `mdxTextExpression`, and top-level import/export declarations. Error names file path, node type, leading snippet chars. - Step 2: reading-time — parse `meta.content` with `remark-parse + remark-gfm` (markdown-only stack, no remark-mdx), invoke `countWordsFromMdast` from task 2, compute `Math.max(1, Math.round(words / 238))`, attach as `readingTime`. - Add `bodyHtml: s.markdown()` and `body: s.mdx()` to the schema. - Slug derivation: `data.slug.replace(/^posts\//, "")`. - Register `posts` in `defineConfig({ collections: { pages, profile, posts } })`. - Purpose: Validate post frontmatter; reject divergence-surface MDX; compute reading time; emit dual outputs. - _Leverage: existing pages schema pattern (velite.config.ts:14); countWordsFromMdast from task 2_ - _Requirements: 1.0, 1.6, 3.7, 4.6, 6.0, 6.1, 11.7a, 11.10_ - _Design refs: "Velite `posts` collection" full section_ - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec blog-core, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Velite/unified-pipeline engineer | Task: Add the `posts` collection per the design's "Velite posts collection" section, including the two-visitor ordered transform (rejection first, reading-time second), the kebab-slug enforcement with the exact Req 4.6 error message, `s.markdown()` bodyHtml emit, and the `]]>` → `]]]]>` substitution applied to bodyHtml inside the transform before return. Mark task in-progress; call log-implementation when done. | Restrictions: DO NOT register `remark-mdx` in the markdown-only reading-time parser stack. Do not skip the try/catch around the rejection-visitor parser. Do not break empty-collection-safety — posts collection must build cleanly with zero matching files. The two-visitor ordering MUST be: rejection → reading-time → bodyHtml. | _Leverage: pages collection pattern, sharedRemarkPlugins/sharedRehypePlugins from task 3, countWordsFromMdast from task 2 | _Requirements: 1.0, 1.6, 3.7, 4.6, 6.0, 6.1, 11.7a, 11.10 | Success: Schema strict-mode rejects unknown frontmatter keys; rejection visitor throws named errors on raw HTML, MDX expressions, JSX tags, imports/exports, and parse failures; reading-time computed correctly on the empty-collection case (skipped). Then mark the task complete after logging._ - [ ] 5.
